item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 11 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 11 #SLPRSD

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Baleno, Aroroy, Mandaon, SanFernando, Batuan, Cataingan, Placer), #Romblon(Cajidiocan, Magdiwang and SanFernando) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
